text: Drelas is a Dunmer mage who resides in his cottage in the mountains of northern Whiterun Hold.
The Draugr Scourge is a variant of draugr and a powerful type of undead that typically serves as a guardian or leader in draugr-filled dungeons.
Dravin Llanith is a Dunmer farmer in who lives with his wife Synda at the Merryfair Farm outside Riften.
Drascua is a Hagraven and leader of a Forsworn clan found at Dead Crone Rock. She can be encountered during the quest "Pieces of the Past."
Dredase Arvel is a Dunmer noble and a member of House Hlaalu residing on the Arvel Plantation.
Dralosa Athren is a Dunmer pauper who can be found wandering around Balmora. She has a house near the canal.

Draugr Scourge Lords are high-level Draugr that are usually found in crypts and Nordic ruins. They are moderately strong and are usually surrounded by weaker Draugr. They usually carry enchanted swords, war axes, and battle axes, which are good weapons to use at earlier levels.
Dram Bero is a Dunmer noble who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton. He is a Councilor for House Hlaalu and the author of Grasping Fortune.
Drayven Indoril, also known as The Nightingale, is a Dunmer mentioned in the historical book The Nightingales Vol. 2 and in the fourth book of The Real Barenziah series.
Dralisi Ienith is a Dunmer sorcerer who resides in the cave of Yesamsi, along with Iirenoore. Both women are hostile, and will attack the Nerevarine on sight.

Dralsea Arethi is a Dunmer commoner who resides in Balmora. She wears common shoes, a common skirt, a common shirt and a common ring. She is often found on in the street east of her house on the east side of Balmora.
Dralval Andrano is a Dunmer apothecary who resides in Balmora. He buys and sells Scrolls and Ingredients.
Dramis Maryon is a Dunmer crusader who resides in the cave of Milk.
Drandryn Omoran is a Dunmer who resides in Morrowind, Minabi.
Dranos Sandus is a Dunmer bandit who resides in Ainat. He will attack the Nerevarine on sight.
Draramu Hloran is a Dunmer sorcerer in who resides in the cave of Abanabi, Morrowind.
Drarayne Girith is an Dunmer Trader who resides in his shop the Plot and Plaster.
Drarel Andus is a Dunmer thief who resides in Vivec City. He will appear in the store of Smith Ralen Tilvur in Vivec Foreign Quarter Canton during the "Guard Ralen Tilvur" quest.
Draron Benelas is a Dunmer smuggler residing in Odirnamat. He will be hostile towards Nerevarine on sight.
Dravil Omavel is a Dunmer slaver who resides in Panat. He will be hostile to the Nerevarine on sight.
Dravynea Fatheran is a Dunmer assassin who resides in Zenarbael, a bandit-inhabited cave in the region of Molag Amur. She is hostile towards the Nerevarine, and will attack them on sight.
Dreamer Prophet is a Dunmer and a member of House Dagoth found in Vivec City. She is responsible for several murders in the Vivec, Foreign Quarter.
Dredyni Salvani is a Dunmer who resides in the cave of Sanabi, in the Ashlands region.
Drelayn Dredayn is a Dunmer priest who resides in The Abbey of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.
Drelis Ondyn is a Dunmer noble who resides in in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.

Dremora, or, to themselves, the Kyn, are a form of humanoid Daedra. They serve a range of Daedric Princes, most notably Mehrunes Dagon, although some are counted in the ranks of Molag Bal, Clavicus Vile and Peryite. they are noted to be one of the few forms of Daedra who prize honor. They have a very militaristic culture, with many ranks and subdivisions within the culture of each clan.
Dreaded-Water is an Argonian Slave who is being held prisoner in the Dunmer stronghold of Hlormaren.
Draugr Lord Aesliip is a unique friendly Draugr found in . He can be found inside the Caves of Fjalding, under the Lake Fjalding on Solstheim.

Dralora Favelnim is a Dunmer commoner, and a member of the East Empire Company, living in Raven Rock. She is the wife of Seler Favelnim and part of the quest "Bar Brawl." The Nerevarine is tasked with checking in on Seler Favelnim to find out why he's brawling with everyone who comes in contact with him. Dralora will plead to the Nerevarine to not hurt her husband, if he tries to fight back.
Drathas Reyas is a Dunmer acrobat who resides in the Great Bazaar in Mournhold.
Dravil Indrano is a Dunmer assassin who resides in the Great Bazaar in Mournhold. He is an agent of the Morag Tong.
Draugr Bane is an undead creature in . It is a stronger variant of the generic draugr.
Draugr Champion is an undead knight in . It is a stronger variant of the generic draugr.
Dreggs is an Orsimer Warrior who resides on the Gro-Bagrat Plantation.

Drayna is a Dunmer spirit found in the Temple of Mourning Springs. She appears here after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed, and the ghosts have returned to the temple. She cannot be interacted with.
Dreams-Simply is an Argonian refugee found in The Gray Mire in Grahtwood.
Drathas Nerus is a Dunmer rogue who leads a gang within the Residential Sewers of Old Mournhold, beneath Godsreach in Mournhold.
Drathus Othral is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu in charge of Ebonheart.
Dralia Farelas is a Dunmer priestess found in the Tribunal Temple of Mournhold.
Dralia Irano is a Dunmer residing in the city of Ebonheart, near the eastern bridge to the city.
Dreams-of-Sleep is an Argonian residing in the Dormitory in Shad Astula.
Dragonstar Guard is a character residing in the town of Dragonstar.
Draitsuul is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Mabrigash Tribe. He is found near the Shrine to Saint Rilms in Deshaan.
Dralas Raloran is a Dunmer part of the group of outlaws found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Vulkhel Guard.
Dralof Waterwalker is a Nord relaxing with his friends at the hotsprings found south of Ratmaster's Prowl.
Dran the Trickster is a Breton reject of the Mages Guild now spending his time playing tricks on passers-by in Fell's Run.
Draren Vedralu is a Dunmer found at the Refugee Relief Sites in Marbruk, Shornhelm, and Stormhold. When delivering a crafting writ to the site, he will give a comment.
Drathyra Othrys is a Dunmer farmer who was driven away from the Sulfur Pools by the Daggerfall Covenant invasion.
Drauginas is an Bosmer member of the Houndsmen found in Jathsogur.
Drauginor is a Bosmer competing in The Champion Division at the Thizzrini Arena.
Draulduin is a scout of the Dominion in the Reconnaissance Camp who was captured by Argonian spies of the Ebonheart Pact. After being freed, he can be found in Woodhearth.
The Drake of Blades is a mysterious, unnamed Imperial who serves with the Dragonguard.
The Dragontail Goat is a pet goat in available through the Crown Store.
Dredaza the Ringmaster is a Xivkyn in the Imperial City Arena District, and serves as the final boss of the Arena.
Draugr Stormlord is a Draugr that appears in . This enemy appears in a few locations, the most notable being Group Dungeons.
Dreet-Wulm is a female Argonian residing at the Northern Morrowind Gate, in Cyrodiil.
Dreams-of-Honey-and-Gold is an Argonian residing in Hallin's Stand.
Dredhedil is a Bosmer member of the Fighters Guild. She acts as the hall steward of their branch in Abah's Landing.
Drarana Selarys is a Dunmer merchant. She sells her wares east of the Prince's Gate.
Dravin Berer is a Dunmer member of the Thieves Guild. He is found inside the Thieves Den in Abah's Landing.
Drelis is a Dunmer residing inside Daynila's house in Stormhold.

The Drake of Shields is an Imperial and one of the last members of the Dragonguard. He is the former mentor of the Drake of Blades. He is found in each of the alliances' bases upon completion of the Imperial City's questline.
Draninus Verrus is an Imperial bard residing in Balmora, and can be found playing a flute outside the Tribunal Temple. He has a pet Vvardvark named Sebystii.

Drelyth Hleran is a Dunmer member of House Redoran found at the entrance of Ald'ruhn. He is seeking to find the location of his family's tomb, and is travels have led him to the Ashlanders' territory.
Dredase-Hlarar is a Dunmer found drinking in the Saint Delyn Plaza on the upper level of the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City.
Dravasa Andalas is a Dunmer residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. He works in the Gnisis egg-mine as an egg-hand. He has no unique dialogue.
Dralosa Arys is a Dunmer mage residing in Tel Branora, in Vvardenfell. She can be found in front of the main tower. She has no unique dialogue.

Dranoth Hleran is a Dunmer Ashlander ancestral ghost haunting Hleran Ancestral Tomb on Vvardenfell. He is the slayer of Skar, the giant emperor crab whose shell now serves as the Ald'ruhn town-center.
Dralane Elarven is a Dunmer located in Bal Fell on Vvardenfell.
Dreadfang is a giant spider boss in that resides inside Toadstool Hollow. Defeating Dreadfang is part of the Toadstool Hollow Explorer achievement.
Drakaws is a Argonian woodworker residing in Alinor, Summerset.
Dreet-Meena is a sleeping Argonian guard who appears outside of Rimmen at the Battle-Ready Market, Rimmen Battlegrounds Camp.
Dredena is a character found in Enrick's Public House in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Dramukkath is an Argonian residing at Lilmoth. He has no unique dialogue.
Dralys Athren is a character in . He is a member of the Sodality of the Eye, and is tasked with protecting the Emerald Glyphic from those who would use it against Hermaeus Mora.
Dro'shanji is a Khajiit and a member of the Thieves Guild. He resides in the city of Bravil and spends most of his time tending to the gardens of Castle Bravil.
Dreyns Telmon is a Dunmer Sorcerer living in Tel Branora. He is a member of House Telvanni.
Driloru Uvaram is a Dunmer living in the Redoran Stronghold of Marandus. She is also a member of House Redoran.
Dridas Salvani is a Dunmer scout who lives in Arenim Manor in Gnaar Mok, Vvardenfell.

Dreyns Nelas is a Buoyant Armiger who resides at the Armigers Stronghold in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He is a Dunmer and a novice member of the Tribunal Temple. Dreyns is not involved in any quests and does not provide any services.
Dul gro-Dush is an Orsimer warrior living in Gnisis in the West Gash. He is also a member of the Imperial Legion.
Druja is an Argonian spell merchant at the Mages Guild in Skingrad. She also trains Expert level Mysticism.

Dubok gro-Shagk is an Orsimer member of the Fighters Guild found in Leyawiin during the guild quest "Drunk and Disorderly." He will be found with his guildmates Vantus Prelius and Rellian at the Five Claws Lodge.

Dul gro-Shug is an Orsimer who lives in his home on the southwest side of the Elven Gardens District in the Imperial City. Near the end of each month, he will take a trip to Skingrad and remain there for two days.

Dro'Nahrahe is a Khajiit working as a steward at Castle Bravil. She might be found traveling along the road north of the Imperial City towards Bruma, then back towards Bravil. There is also a chance of her dying while traveling. She is not involved in any quests, nor does she offer any services.

Duke Vedam Dren is a Dunmer Knight living in Ebonheart. He is the current Duke of the Imperial District of Vvardenfell, and the father of Ilmeni Dren and the brother of Orvas Dren. He resides in the Grand Council Chambers, where he does most of his work. Duke Vedam Dren is required to complete many of the quests for House Hlaalu, such as "Control the Ordinators" and "Dealing with Orvas Dren," which are required to become Grandmaster of the House.
Dryngheid is a non-hostile Nord Barbarian who resides outside of Zaintiraris, Morrowind. Dryngheid is a worshiper of Sheogorath.
Drevis Neloren is a Dunmer mage at the College of Winterhold.
Dro'marash is a Khajiit warrior found traveling alongside Ahkari.
Drifa is a Nord pawnbroker in Riften. She is the wife of Bersi Honey-Hand and co-owner of The Pawned Prawn.
Dryston is a Breton Forsworn residing in The Warrens of Markarth.

Drennen was a Nord warrior. He was an explorer who sought the Lexicon at the Dwemer Ruin of Avanchnzel, where he died. The expedition included Drennen, From-Deepest-Fathoms, Breya, and Watches-The-Roots. His corpse can be found at the Avanchnzel Animoncultory.
Dremora Captains are Dremora found in the Citadel. They are aggressive humanoid servants of Mehrunes Dagon. There are three captains in total. They use leveled Dremora armor and weapons.
Dremora Hatred Keeper is a Dremora in . There are two Dremora Hatred Keepers located in the Random Oblivion World 2, Citadel Lava area. They are aggressive humanoid servants of Mehrunes Dagon.
Dremora Sigil Keeper is a Dremora in . There is a Dremora Sigil Keeper in the tower of the Kvatch Oblivion Gate guarding Menien Goneld in the cage.
Drendrisa Fareloth is a Dunmer barbarian, and resides in the cave of Kunirai. She will attack the Nerevarine on sight.
Drerel Indaren is a Dunmer Commoner who resides in the Ashlands of Morrowind. Drerel became separated from his wife, Falanu, after they encountered a group of Nix-Hounds.
Dreynis Nothro is a Dunmer spellsword who is one of the bodyguards of Farvyn Oreyn.
Drinar Varyon is a Dunmer who resides in Ald'ruhn. He is a smuggler of stolen goods and works for Odral Helvi. Also, he deals Raw Ebony and Dwemer artifacts.
Drireri Berano is a Dunmer warrior residing in Ularradallaku.
Drodos Galen is a Dunmer Sorcerer, and member of House Telvanni who can be found at Tel Naga. They are a Lawman rank in House Telvanni.
Drolora Salen is a Dunmer Drillmaster residing in Morrowind. She is a member of House Hlaalu.
Drores Arvel is a Dunmer witchhunter residing in Ald Daedroth. He is an Ordinator of the Tribunal Temple. He is in Ald Daedroth to clean out the Daedra worshippers.
Drulene Falen is a Dunmer guar herder who can be found outside of her hut west of Ald'ruhn.
Drulvan Rindo is a Dunmer Commoner who resides in the Vivec, Hlaalu Canton. He can be found walking around the topmost floor of the canton, Hlaalu Plaza.
Drurile Valaai is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.
Dro'Tasarr is a Khajiit commoner residing in the city of Ald'ruhn. He is typically found in The Rat in the Pot inn, or walking around the city.
Dro'Zhirr is a Khajiit thief residing inside Shushishi cave east of Caldera.

Dreugh are creatures in . They are the younger stage of the more commonly found Land Dreugh. Upon reaching the appropriate age, the Dreugh enters metamorphosis to become a Land Dreugh, moving its habitat from water to land. Land Dreughs, however, are not found in Morrowind.

Dudley is a hostile Redguard warrior and bandit who resides in Yasamsi. He lives there together with three other smugglers, Larisus Dergius, Ralos Othrenim, and Thervam Drelas. He is one of the murderer of Julielle Aumine.
Dro'Sakhar is a Khajiit thief living in Canal South-Two at the St. Olms Canton of Vivec City.

Dreyla Alor is a Dunmer living on Solstheim. She is the daughter of Fethis Alor. She can be found in Raven Rock. Just like the other villagers of Raven Rock, she can also be found at the Earth Stone working on it and worshiping it. When she does, she acts and sounds like she has been indoctrinated.

Drovas Relvi is a Dunmer found working at The Retching Netch Inn at Raven Rock. Drovas can be seen working at the Earth Stone while under the control of Miraak, when the Dragonborn arrives at Raven Rock. After he is freed, he resumes his work at the Retching Netch.

Drengr Bronze-Helm is a historical character mentioned in Thirsk, a History, and subsequent revisions of the book, such as, Thirsk, a Revised History. Contender to Hrothmund the Red as the new leader of the Thirsk Mead Hall, he was beheaded in the duel that followed. His head was put on display in the middle of the Hall to serve as a reminder of Hrothmund's victory. This began the long tradition of the Chieftains of Thirsk Mead Hall placing their greatest battle trophies on display in the Mead Hall.

Drothmeri Steward is a Dunmer Drothmeri steward found in the Sundercliff Watch when first entering the cave during the Unearthing Mehrunes' Razor quest. He uses heavy armor and one can find the Steward's Note in his pocket. His Small Diary can be found in a knapsack in the same area.

Drothmeri Commander Telani Andrethi is a Dunmer Marauder boss found in Sundercliff Watch in his house next to Frathen Drothan's quarter's in Sundercliff Commune. He is the leader of the Drothmeri Army.
Drusus Gratus is a Dunmer guard. He is a member of the Royal Guard and protects King Hlaalu Helseth inside the Royal Palace Throne Room. He uses a full set of Royal Guard Armor.
Dro'Zah is a Khajiit slave who resides in the Abebaal Egg Mine. Dro'Zah, as well as the rest of the slaves in the mine, is owned by House Telvanni and is in the middle of a revolt.
Duharr is a Khajiit merchant found in Eagle's Strand. Despite being a merchant, he does not provide any services.
Dro'zharim is a Khajiit pauper who is being held in the Tel Vos Jail.
Dro'Qanar is a Khajiit slave who resides in the Vivec, Telvanni Canton.
Dro'Barri is a Khajiit commoner residing in the St. Delyn Canton of Vivec City.
Duke Nathaniel is a Breton Duke residing in Alcaire Keep, in Alcaire Castle. He is the brother of High King Emeric and is married to Lakana, the daughter of King Fahara'jad for political reasons.
Drinlin is Bosmer clothier residing in Vulkhel Guard, Auridon. He can be found at his shop, Summerset Outfitters, selling his wares.
Drillk is a mad member of the Kothringi and is the last surviving member of the tribe. He thinks he is a king and seems to think that he isn't the only one left.

Drill Sergeant Berouche is a Breton sergeant in Aldcroft, Glenumbra, who thinks the soldiers are unfit. He can be found near the Lionguard Camp Market drilling his soldiers to do jumping jacks and push-ups.
Duke Sebastien is a Breton and the exiled leader of Camlorn. After he was exiled, he relocated to Aldcroft, where he was then kidnapped and held hostage by reachmen of the Bloodthorn Cult.
Dufrain is a Breton beggar found in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found around town.
Dufbash is an Orsimer residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. She is sitting down, leaning against Undusha's stall at the Dockside Trading Stalls near the docks.
Dugroth is an Orsimer residing on the island of Stros M'Kai. He must make up his mind whether to be a warrior or a smith and the Vestige can help him decide.
Duchess Lakana is a Redguard residing in Alcaire Keep in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. She's the daughter of King Fahara'jad and is married to Duke Nathaniel.
Dromash is an Orsimer guild trader residing in Stormhaven. He has a guild stall near Travelers' Rest.
Dugug is an Orsimer in Grahtwood. He can be found drinking at the Sarandel's Carnival. When spoken to, he has little to say and will return to his drink rather than talk.
Dreska Delenu is a Dunmer found in the Guild Plaza in Mournhold. She listens to Ophalia Strong-Voice's singing.
Drondar Aralas is a Dunmer mystic. He sells her wares at his stall, Aralas' Arcane Implements, in the Royal Bazaar of Mournhold.
Duk-Marza is an Argonian residing in the Fighters Guild in Mournhold.
Drinks-With-Toes is an Argonian banker in who resides at his stand "Drinks-Not-Investments" in the Dhalmora Hall of Merchants, Bal Foyen.
Druga Hammerhand is a Nord clothier residing in the city of Evermore. She can be found at the local smithy, selling her wares.
Drinks-With-Crabs is an Argonian residing in the city of Ebonheart, Stonefalls.
Drifts-On-Wind is an Argonian residing at the docks in Mournhold or in the ponds in Shad Astula.
Drissa Gilenim is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild residing on the island of Eyevea.
Drienne gro-Olgum is an Orsimer laborer found in Daggerfall.
Drinks-On-Sails is an Argonian found on the Vulkhel Guard docks.
Drinroth is a Bosmer member of the Supernal Dreamers found at Vaermina's Shrine in Cyrodiil.
Drivas is a weaponsmith and a member of the Fighters Guild. He is found inside the Marbruk Fighters Guild Hall where he also sells his wares at his stall, Drivas' Wealth of Blades.
Dro-Dara is a Khajiit, a retired member of the Mages Guild and a retired explorer. He is found at his ruined plantation east of Wayrest.
Droi is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found in Kynesgrove.
Druitularg is a powerful hostile Dremora found at his altar located northwest of Tal'Deic Fortress.
Drujal is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild found at the enclave in Hissmir.

The Duchess of Anguish is a powerful Xivkyn ruling over the Halls of Torment where she is currently torturing Sai Sahan for the location of the Amulet of Kings. She is a skilled torturer who has written on the subject.
Dugan the Red is a notorious Orsimer bandit in the Malabal Tor region. He can be found with his fellow bandits at his camp Dugan's Knoll.
Dugrul is the Orsimer commander of the Daggerfall Covenant forces who are hiding in Softloam Cavern, in the region of Stonefalls.
Dugrul gro-Ogdula is an Orsimer fisherman residing in the city of Wayrest, Stormhaven. He can be found north of the Wayrest Mages Guild.
Dugtosh is an Orsimer residing in the city of Shornhelm, Rivenspire.
Dugugikh is an Orsimer guild trader residing at the outlaws refuge in the town of Marbruk, Greenshade.
Duke Renchant is the Breton mayor of the city of Evermore. He became in charge of the city after the death of his brother and former leader, King Eamond.
Duk-Makka is an Argonian worshipper of Sanguine found in Sanguine's Demesne.
Drodda's Dreadlord is a Draugr found in Direfrost Keep. He was raised by Drodda of Icereach when she moved in.
Drinoth is a Bosmer residing in Cyrodill. He is a worshipper of Vaermina and can be found at her Shrine.
Duadeen is a half Akaviri mercenary who works with S'rathra.
Drinar Vilas is a Dunmer residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Driliame Sedrethi is a Dunmer found in the outlaws refuge underneath Anvil. She cannot be interacted with.
Drivanas Gilvilo is a Dunmer carpenter. She offers her services at her store, The Carved Bough, in Anvil.
Drodda's Apprentice is a hostile Nord mage residing in Direfrost Keep in Eastmarch.
Druxolneeus is an Argonian residing at the Percolating Mire.
Drunk Cultist is an unused Breton in . She was supposed to make an appearance during the quest "A Night to Remember," but was not added to the final version of the game.
Drienne Arne is a Breton laborer found inside the manor in Skywatch.
Dreyla Rothan is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Kagesh Tribe. She is found at their camp near Iliath Temple.
Drod Quick-Feet is a Nord hunter residing in Windhelm, Eastmarch. She is one of the celebrants of the Konunleikar. She has no unique dialogue.
Duke of Crows is a Crow found initially in the Crow's Wood. He is a member of Blackfeather Court.
Droval the Sharp is a Dunmer residing in Balmora, Vvardenfell.

Dro'Zel was the King of Elsweyr at the end of the First Era. Dro'Zel was known for being a madman with a mentality of child. He served the Reman Empire well when in Sun's Dusk of 1E 2920, he was an advisor to the Imperial Court. On the 16th of Sun's Dusk, Dro'Zel contacted Molag Bal, the Daedric Prince of Domination and Rape to destroy the large city of Gil-Var-Delle. His reasoning was that a Bard from Gil-Var-Delle told a tale to Dro'Zel poorly and he was extremely distraught about it, resulting in neverending anger. His decision to destroy Gil-Var-Delle inspired Sotha Sil of the Tribunal to create a pact with the Daedric Princes where most not interact with their devoters. This was eventua
Drurile Gavos is a Dunmer scholar residing in the Saint Olms Waistworks in the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue.
Dridyn Ledd is a Dunmer merchant working at the Trading House in Vos, on the island of Vvardenfell.
Drowned Dog Fire Mage is a generic character residing in several locations in .
Dreyla Indavel is a Dunmer member of House Telvanni and an apprentice of Divayth Fyr residing in Tel Fyr on Vvardenfell.
Dro-m'Athra Sun-Eater is a member of the Dro-m'Athra residing in Reaper's March.
Dro-m'Athra Savage is a member of the Dro-m'Athra residing in Reaper's March.
Dro-m'Athra Illusionist is a member of the Dro-m'Athra residing in Reaper's March.
Dro-m'Athra Dreadstalker is a member of the Dro-m'Athra residing in Reaper's March.

Dremora Rathine, also known as Lord Rathine, is a Dremora found in The Weir Gate. He is a servant of Lord Methats, and is only hostile to enemies of Methats. He carries the Cog of Pinion Precession, one of the five cogs required to open the way to the Star Galley.

Demora Methats, also known as Lord Methats, is a Dremora found in The Weir Gate. Mentioning his name may be enough to cause other Daedra to flee or even fight alongside the Apprentice. He possesses the Lord Methats' Steel Pauldron, which may be exchanged for Clarentavious' Staff of the Typos Sophia. Generally, speaking to Methats will result in combat.
Dremora Tanchelm is a Dremora found in Caitiff. He is a non-hostile character and will offer the scroll Spirit of the Daedra to The Apprentice.
Dremora Gatanas is a Dremora found in Caitiff. He will task The Apprentice with retrieving the voidguide and delivering it to Rishaal Tamir.
Drorayni Fandas is a Dunmer provisioner who can be found in Mathon's House in Mud Tree Village, Shadowfen. She has no unique dialogue.
Dritan is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe residing in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.

Dres Ancestor Spirit is an ancestor of House Dres in who is found in the Library of Andule. He blocks the way into the Dres section of the library, until the player have answered three of his questions correctly. Clues can be found in the nearby book Understanding House Dres.
Drevis is a Dunmer residing in The Randy Netch Inn in Balmora. He is one of Veya Releth's friends helping her uncover the fate of her missing brother.

Druid Olivya is a Breton druid of the Stonelore Circle in . She can be found at active volcanic vents accross the High Isle and Amenos. The Vestige can help her in sealing the vents by defeating the creatures that appear during the ritual.
Dubdil Alar is a Dunmer mage of House Telvanni in . He can be found conducting a ritual in front of his tower in Vvardenfell along with his assistants.
Drublog Firelights are generic archer enemies who are members of the Drublog Clan.
Dremora Lyrkynaz is a Dremora in that is a part of the Arms of Chaos Creation Club content.
Dremora Sovereign is a Dremora in that is a part of the Arms of Chaos Creation Club content.

Dutadalk is a Dunmer Hunter and is a member of the Ahemmusa Tribe of Ashlanders. He resides in the Ahemmusa Camp inside Dutadalk's Yurt. Dutadalk hunts for food and spends most of his time in his yurt in the ashlander camp.

Dulfish gro-Orum is an Orsimer barbarian who lives in Cheydinhal. He is the leader of a skooma ring in the city along with his possible brother Magub gro-Orum, Borba gra-Uzgash, Bazur gro-Gharz and Oghash gra-Magul.
Dumac, also known as Dumac Dwarf-Orc, and Dumac Dwarfking, or Dumalacath, was the last king of the Dwemer and head of the clans in Resdayn before the disappearance of his race during the First Era.
Duma gro-Lag is an Orsimer bard and sculptor who lives in Ghorak Manor in Caldera.
Dumbuk gro-Bolak is an Orsimer member of the Imperial Legion living in Wolverine Hall in Sadrith Mora. He can also be found in the Barracks in Gnisis.
Dumag gro-Bonk is an Orsimer blacksmith who owns The Missing Pauldron in Bliss of the Shivering Isles.
Durzogs are creatures in . They are often used by Goblins to hunt and kill adventurers as well as other enemies.
Dunius Valodius is an Imperial slaver who resides in the cave of Shushan. He mainly deals in Khajiits and Argonians slaves there.

Durus Marius is an Imperial Assassin who resides in the shrine Assernerairan, Morrowind. Durus is a member of the Dark Brotherhood and a worshipper of Mehrunes Dagon. He carries the Belt of Sanguine Hewing and the Belt of Sanguine Sureflight.
Dushnamub is an Orsimer and the blacksmith for the stronghold of Narzulbur.
Dulug is an Orsimer miner who works at the Dushnikh Mine, within the stronghold of Dushnikh Yal.

Dumania Jirich is an Imperial located in Anvil. She is the acting Primate of the Chapel of Dibella until she is killed by Umaril the Unfeathered once the events of begin. At the end of the quest line, she is replaced as Primate of Dibella by Selene Duronia.
Duldrar Saren is a Dunmer Warrior residing at the Ministry of Truth in Vivec City. He is a member of the Tribunal Temple.
Duldresi Senim is a Dunmer bandit residing in the cave of Odibaal.
Dulnea Ralaal is a Dunmer publican who can be found at the Eight Plates inn in Balmora.
Dun-Ilu Assurnumausur is a Dunmer Miner residing in Caldera Mine.

Dunsalipal Dun-Ahhe is the Dunmer Master for the Morag Tong in the Sadrith Mora, guild hall. He is one of the characters capable of giving payment for the contracts given to the Nerevarine. He offers training in Short Blade (up to 69), Light Armor (up to 64) and Marksman (up to 64).
Dulian is a Redguard Priest, and member of the Imperial Legion who resides in the Buckmoth Legion Fort.
Durzub gro-Bogamakh is an Orsimer Barbarian found in Bal Fell, West Wing. They are an associate-rank member of the Mages Guild.
Durzum gro-Shagrak is a hostile Orsimer Barbarian slaver who resides in the Dunmer stronghold of Hlormaren. He is located in the underground level of the stronghold's keep.
Durak is an Orsimer ranger and member of the Dawnguard. According to dialogue, he joined the order to avenge the deaths of his two wives, who were killed by vampires.
Dulk is a Riekling found in . He is the leader of the Rieklings found inside Castle Karstaag.

Dulphumph gro-Urgash is an Orsimer warrior who resides in the village of Deepwallow in the Dementia side of Shivering Isles. He is an self-proclaimed Scalon killer, and can usually either be found at his house or southwest of Deepwallow hunting for Scalons. His house is between Erver Devani's and Beelei's houses.

Durcorach the Black Drake was a Reachman who led an invasion against the Bretons of High Rock in 2E 541 during the Interregnum. Durcorach was killed by King Emeric in 2E 542 at the gates of Daggerfall, where his army of Reachmen was broken and scattered after a failed attack on the city of Daggerfall in High Rock.
Durbul gro-Rush is the Orsimer Commoner, and foreman working on the construction of Rethan Manor for House Hlaalu and, potentially, the Nerevarine.
Duluk gro-Ghash is a hostile Orsimer Barbarian residing in the Dwemer Ruins of Mzuleft.
Dur gro-Grambak is an Orsimer Barbarian, and a worshipper of Malacath. He resides in the cave of Shashpilamat, in the Azura's Coast region.
Durz gro-Olor is an Orsimer warrior residing in Valenvaryon.
Durz gra-Rimph is an Orsimer Warrior who resides in Assurdirapal in the region of Sheogorad in Morrowind.
Durgat gra-Glurkub is a hostile Orsimer Barbarian who resides in the Dwemer Ruins of Mzuleft.

Durena Avani is a Dunmer armorer residing in the city of Davon's Watch, Stonefalls. She sells her wares at her stall, The War-Worn Carapace, in the market district. She is the daughter of Merail Avani and her brother Arvys Avani works as a weaponsmith.
Dumburz gro-Bulfish is an Orsimer Pauper residing at Khartag Point, where he is staying during the construction of the shrine of Boethiah.
Dulroi gra-Gruumsh is an Orsimer commoner residing in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found sitting on the hill overlooking the ships at the Daggerfall Docks.
Dumurzog is an Orsimer, residing in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. She has a stall in the local marketplace, but it has been closed by the guards.
Durzog Jonnicent is an Orsimer residing in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He is found near the Daggerfall Wayshrine, looking over the docks.
Dururo Hlan is a Dunmer brewer. He sells his wares at his stall, Comestibulary, in the Royal Bazaar of Mournhold.
Dusty-Claws is an Argonian beggar residing outside the Tribunal Temple in Mournhold. His group was attacked and he asks the Vestige to donate him money.
Duryn Beleran is a Dunmer member of House Dres residing in the city of Kragenmoor.
Duzal-ja is a Khajiit chef. He works at The Waxing Crescent in Rawl'kha.
Durrali is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. She is the innkeeper and proprietor of the Silver Moons Inn at their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Dushug is an Orsimer residing in Koeglin Village. She can be found on the docks next to Baryctor Ales by the fruit stall. She has no unique dialogue.
Dulia is a Redguard guild trader selling her wares at the Dockside Dealers in the port city of Mistral, in Khenarthi's Roost.
Dulini is a Khajiit member of the Merethic Society. He is found at Rulanyil's Fall, searching for tresures that were hidden there by the organization.
Dumolg gro-Grush is an Orsimer warrior with Lob the Cleaver's warband, the Stormfist Clan, who took over Cradlecrush in Eastmarch.
Dumuguk is an Orsimer scholar in the Crossroads Tavern in Belkarth, Craglorn.
Dunimond Gedanis is a Breton patron of The Run Inn in Fell's Run.
Duraeg is the leader of the group of Dark Witnesses doing foul rituals in Northglen. He can be found in Duraeg's House performing the ritual on Isabeth Gaercroft.
Durel Gilveni is a Dunmer found in the crypts beneath the Tal'Deic Fortress.
Durodir is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Dune.
Dushgor is an Orsimer member of the Lhurgash Clan part of Warchief Gorzesh's warband.
Duzi is a Khajiit commoner found at the Temple of Two-Moons Dance.

Duzuni is a deceased Khajiit member of the Fighters Guild. She died fighting the daedra that poured out of the Oblivion Gates that were opened in Firsthold. Her corpse is found at their branch once the daedra are defeated.
Dulan is a Khajiit found at Hadran's Caravan. He oversees the lizard races there.
Durogbesh is an Orsimer member of the Barkbite Clan residing in the city of Reman's Bluff, Grahtwood.
Dusk Singer is a Khajiit Tel Var armorer and a member of the Dominion. She is found at their base inside the Imperial City Sewers.
Dumoga is an Orsimer stablemaster found in Orsinium. She runs the Shatul Clan Corral, a stable opposite the main gate.
Durhaz is a young Orsimer mage found in the Orsinium Mages Guild in the city of Orsinium. She is a member of Mages Guild.
